findings.description: The Lambda function's environment variables contain a plaintext AWS access key and secret key (AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE / wJalrXUtnFEMI...). These are hard-coded secrets embedded in the Terraform configuration and will be stored in plaintext in the Lambda configuration and state file, risking credential theft.

No kms_key_arn is specified for the Lambda function, so environment variables (including the embedded secret key material) are encrypted only with the default AWS-managed key rather than a customer-managed KMS key, weakening control over encryption at rest for sensitive data.
The function uses the nodejs12.x runtime, which is deprecated and no longer receives security patches from the language/runtime maintainers or AWS, increasing exposure to unpatched vulnerabilities.
